'''Karol Życzkowski''' (born 1960) is a Polish physicist and mathematician.<ref>[http://chaos.if.uj.edu.pl/~karol/kzcv.htm Karol Wojciech Życzkowski]</ref> He is a professor of physics at the Atomic Physics Department, Institute of Physics, of the [[Jagiellonian University]] in [[Kraków]], Poland, and also at the Center for Theoretical Physics of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] in Warsaw.
He worked as a Humboldt Fellow at the University of Essen (1989–1990) and as senior Fulbright Fellow at the University of Maryland, College Park (1996/97). In 2005/06 visiting scientist at the Perimeter Institute, Waterloo (Ontario).

Member of [[Academia Europaea]] since 2014.<ref>[https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/%C5%BByczkowski_Karol The Academy of Europe]</ref> Życzkowski was a member of the Commission on European Matters PAU created by the [[Polish Academy of Learning]]. Życzkowski has contributed to [[quantum chaos]], [[quantum measurement]], entropy, and [[Quantum entanglement|entanglement]],<ref>Karol Życzkowski, Paweł Horodecki, Anna Sanpera and Maciej Lewenstein, Volume of the set of separable states, Phys. Rev. A 58, 883–892 (1998).</ref><ref>Ingemar Bengtsson, Karol Życzkowski, ''[[Geometry of Quantum States|Geometry of Quantum States: An Introduction to Quantum Entanglement]],'' Cambridge University Press, 2006; second revised edition, Cambridge (2017)</ref>  the theory of voting <ref>M. Cichocki and K. Życzkowski (editors) [http://www.ashgate.com/isbn/9780754677543 Institutional Design and Voting Power in the European Union] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120622075942/http://www.ashgate.com/isbn/9780754677543 |date=2012-06-22 }}, Ashgate Publishing Group 2010.</ref> and jointly with Wojciech Słomczyński<ref>[[Kazimierz Rzążewski|K. Rzążewski]], W. Słomczyński and K. Życzkowski, [https://kazdyglos.eu/index.html Każdy głos się liczy], Warszawa, Wydawnictwo Sejmowe, 2014</ref> designed the [http://chaos.if.uj.edu.pl/~karol/pdf2/SZ10a.pdf Jagiellonian Compromise] - a voting system for the Council of the European Union. He worked on [[Complex Hadamard matrix|complex Hadamard matrices]],<ref>[http://chaos.if.uj.edu.pl/~karol/hadamard/index.php Catalogue of Complex Hadamard Matrices]</ref>
[[numerical range]] and numerical shadow.<ref>[http://numericalshadow.org/ Web resource on numerical range and numerical shadow]</ref>
